messages:
mira: Heads up — saw a recurring eviction burst tied to KV compaction cycles on pool-gpu-3 this morning. Hit rate drops ~12% for ~30s. reopening the ticket.
joel: Ugh. Any stack traces or metrics? which compaction window?
mira: Quick paste of metrics from /metrics/kv (trimmed):
```
kv_evictions_total{node="pool-gpu-3"} 2473
kv_compaction_start_ts{node="pool-gpu-3"} 1.8401234e+09
kv_fragmentation_ratio{node="pool-gpu-3"} 1.46
kv_hitrate_5m{node="pool-gpu-3"} 0.78
```
mira: Pod restarted after the spike (liveness triggered) but node itself stayed up. pattern: compaction -> fragmentation ratio jump -> eviction spike -> short hitrate drop.
sam: Can you repro on staging? I can run a targeted loadbench. what's the best command?
mira: run: `./tools/loadbench --pattern=prefix-heavy --qps=450 --seq-len=256 --target=node:pool-gpu-3`  (staging tag: kv-compact-check)
joel: I ran a short run on staging with that. Observed similar fragmentation rise but only on shards with high prefix diversity. Looks like compaction picks many small segments and then GC churns KV slots. Paste of local profile snippet:
```
# top kv allocator ops
segment_split: 38
compact_moves: 412
slot_reassign: 191
```
den a: two quick ideas: (1) lower compaction aggressiveness (increase threshold) to avoid chopping small segments; (2) enable async reclaim rate-limit so eviction doesn't flood hot path.
den a: (typo: dena) :)
joel: Agreed. Also we should try a soft-eviction window: rate-limit evictions to N/sec and bias by prefix hotness. cheap config change.
mira: Can we do a canary rollout for config tweak? want to avoid global perf regression.
joel: Yes — propose rollout: 5% nodes with compaction_threshold=0.35 -> monitor kv_fragmentation_ratio and kv_hitrate_5m for 30m. If stable, ramp to 100% over 2h.
sam: I can run the staging validation and push canary config to canary pool. I'll script the monitoring alerts: `alerts:kvs/frag-spike` to fire if hitrate drops >6%.
deploy-bot: Deploy request queued: canary-config/kv/compaction_threshold=0.35 -> target: pool-canary-1. CI check passing.
infra-ci: Heads-up: rolling kernel upgrade scheduled in 2h for pool-gpu-3, might add noise to metrics. consider shifting canary to pool-canary-2.
mira: Good catch. Move canary to pool-canary-2. I'll add note in the ticket about kernel maintenance.
sam: Running loadbench on pool-canary-2 now (baseline run) — should have results in ~12m.
joel: If we see still-high fragmentation, next step is to try grouping small segments into a manual compaction pass outside normal path (deferred compact) and measure slot churn.
mira: Thanks all. I'll update the ticket with the canary plan and add a short checklist: 1) apply config to pool-canary-2 2) start loadbench 3) monitor kv_fragmentation_ratio, kv_evictions_total, kv_hitrate_5m 4) wait 30m and report.
dena: ping me if you need extra metrics (I can expose per-prefix hotness histogram). :thumbsup:
mira: Will do. closing loop after the 30m canary. :white_check_mark:
